description: This file defines a specific exception class, SecurityNotAllowedTagError, within the Twig templating engine's Sandbox component. The class is thrown when an unauthorized tag is used within a template, extending the base SecurityError class and adding a property for the tag name that caused the error.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedTagError
classes.description: An exception class indicating that a not allowed tag was encountered in a Twig template. It extends SecurityError and stores the name of the offending tag.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error message and tag name related to the not allowed tag.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the name of the tag that triggered this exception.
